prof_layi.name: PROF LAYI
prof_layi.tone: Deadpan satirical faux-intellectual wisdom, high-sounding legalism, absurd economic proverbs, street-smart orator
prof_layi.hook_formula: Authoritative didactic command or pseudo-philosophical proverb ('Keep quiet, let me talk to you', 'The proof of knowledge is demonstration', 'Nobody wants to accompany who is not accomplished')
narrative_structure: 1. Didactic Hook ('Keep quiet, let me talk to you. The proof of knowledge is demonstration.')
2. The Fallacy Breakdown ('My mentor told me that the suffering of many people is the fallacy of thinking...')
3. Absurd Economic Illustration ('You say money cannot solve all problems, but economic reality has no mercy for sentiments.')
4. The Philosophical Escalation ('Those that run after money cannot run a business. Currency was created to be current.')
5. Masterclass Maxim / Benediction ('From the state of financial breakdown to the state of financial breakthrough. Information is what makes a man fly.')
